name: Archery Range
hook: Read the wind. Hit the gold. The target keeps moving back.
how: Take turns shooting at one target, three arrows a round, while everyone watches through your sight. The wind changes every arrow and the target moves back every round, from 18 to 70 metres. Highest total wins.
controls: Press and hold to draw, drag to aim, let go to shoot (mouse or finger); or hold Space and use the arrow keys
uses: Each player's best total, shown on the results card.
The host's browser sets the wind, scores every arrow and runs the turns; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots shoot in the empty places, and take over for anyone who leaves.
Everyone watches each archer aim and follows every arrow to the target.
ideas: Add a moving target that slides left and right
Make it a medieval castle tournament with banners
Add a fire arrow you can use once per match for double points
